tabs.tab1_description:
Black Cat’s Eye gemstone is a chrysoberyl variety and a rare and enticing gem known for its unique optical phenomenon and dark, mysterious appearance. This gemstone gets its name from the eye-catching cat's eye effect it produces when exposed to direct light. The presence of fine, needle-like inclusions within the gem creates this effect, which reflects and concentrates light to form a captivating luminous band resembling a cat's eye slit. Black Cat's Eye gemstones are typically dark green to black in color, with a chatoyant effect that lends the gem an alluring and mystical quality.

Black Cat's Eye gemstones are highly sought after by collectors and connoisseurs due to their scarcity and stunning appearance. They are frequently used in high-end jewelry, especially rings, pendants, and earrings, where their unique beauty can be highlighted. These gemstones have been associated with protective and mystical properties throughout history, making them popular choices for people looking for both elegance and symbolism in their jewelry. Black Cat's Eye gemstones continue to fascinate and captivate gem enthusiasts all over the world, whether worn as a talisman or simply as a statement piece.

Black Cat’s Eye gemstone is an exceptionally powerful and beautiful assortment of the Chrysoberyl mineral family in order to balance the Muladhara or root chakra, our base and denser energy center with its deep dark black color. The meaning of Cats Eye stone is pretty simple and refers to the optical effect of the vertical ray of light that passes through this gemstone is known as ‘Chatoyance’ as it makes it look like the eye of a cat.

Discovered by Geologist Abraham Gottlob Werner, this stone serves as a great instrument in neutralizing the malefic effects of planet Ketu. It was believed by people of the ancient world to attract good fortune. It is said to be the stone of protection against mishaps, evil schemes of enemies and accidents.

Black Cats Eye stone miraculously wards off evil and negative energies from the wearer’s life. It acts as a talisman and safeguards the wearer from unknown enemies and less known dangers. This stone is popularly known to attract unexpected wealth and prosperity and it also helps people to regain their lost wealth. 

Black Cats Eye stone boosts willpower, intelligence, awareness, and knowledge. It also provides spiritual uplift. The Cat's Eye attracts and amplifies good fortune and positivity. It aids in the removal of all negative energy from an individual's aura. It is a stone that fulfills wishes of the wearer and brings good luck. It is also known to keep negative energies at bay.

Although Black Cats Eye gemstone is available in multiple colors besides black, its cosmic color is infra-red, which is associated with the root chakra, located at the base of the spine. Black Cat’s eye gemstone is therefore associated with all the essential needs for our survival, all the things that provide us with safety and allow us to live.

Although Black Cat’s Eye gemstone can be worn by anyone for its healing, mystic and other benefits, it is highly recommended that an astro and chakra expert consultation is sought before wearing Black Cat’s Eye. In Chakra science, it helps open and balance the Root Chakra. Thus, it is highly recommended for those looking for relief from stress, peace of mind and calmness. 

One may also consult a Chakra analyst or a Vedic astrologer to check the compatibility of the stone. This gemstone blesses with a soothing feeling and relaxing effect. You can take advantage of our expert advice on the suitability and compatibility of wearing this stone.   

The Black Cat's Eye gemstone is frequently recommended for those seeking to harness its powerful grounding energies. In Vedic astrology, this gemstone is associated with the planet Ketu and is thought to have a profound effect on one's spiritual and mental well-being. Wearing a black cats eye gemstone may benefit people with either a strong Ketu influence in their birth chart or those facing challenges related to the Ketu planet, such as mundane hurdles or spiritual growth. It is believed to aid people in overcoming obstacles, developing intuition, and gaining clarity on their life's path.

Black Cat’s Eye gemstone is thought to boost one's confidence, courage, and self-esteem by enhancing the energy of the root chakra, allowing individuals to face life's challenges with resilience and a strong sense of purpose. The grounding properties of this gemstone can also help people feel more connected to the earth and rooted in the present moment, fostering a sense of balance and inner strength.

Furthermore, black cats eye gemstones are sometimes recommended for those looking for protection against negative energies and accidents. Black Cat’s Eye gemstone wards off evil spirits and protects against unforeseen dangers. 

Important Details:  

Note that one should only wear natural, unheated, untreated Cat’s Eye gemstones so they can experience healing and empowerment. Rudra Centre only deals in 100% natural, unheated, untreated Cat’s Eye gemstones.  

Black Cat’s Eye Buying Guide

Check its Origin:

Black Cat's Eye gemstones are mainly sourced from India, Sri Lanka, and Brazil. India, especially Orissa, is known for producing high-quality Black Cat's Eye gemstones with exceptional chatoyancy and deep black hues. However, Sri Lanka continues to produce the highest-quality Black Cat's Eye gemstone. Smaller deposits in Madagascar, Myanmar, and some African countries are less commonly associated with Black Cat's Eye gemstone production.

Observe their Color:

The black cats eye gemstone is usually dark green to black. The dark color creates a striking chatoyant effect, resembling a cat's eye under direct light. Black Cat's Eye gemstones are highly prized for their deep and enigmatic hue, adding to their allure and making them sought after for jewelry and talismans.

Notice their Clarity:

Black Cat's Eye gemstone's clarity is important for its value and visual appeal, and because it affects its chatoyancy effect. Gemstones with fewer flaws and a clear cat's eye are more valuable and desirable. 

Examine their Inclusions:

Some inclusions or "silk" in Black Cat's Eye gemstones are acceptable as they create the black cat's eye effect. The ideal is to find a balance between clearness and the strength of the chatoyancy in these gemstones.

See their Shape:

Cabochons, with their smooth, polished domed surface, are among the most popular cuts for Black Cat's Eye gemstones because they brilliantly display the chatoyancy. Round and oval shapes are also popular because they can display the cat's eye effect in a balanced and symmetrical way.

Check the Carats:

For Cat’s Eye of gem quality, the raw Cat’s Eye is divided and polished into smaller stones of variable carat weight. In general, Cat’s Eye weighing 4 carats and above are appropriate for jewelry. Because Cat’s Eye is sold by weight, Cat’s Eye prices are calculated per carat. Stones of comparable dimensions but distinct varieties vary greatly in price. The more carats and clarity Cat’s Eye has, the higher its price.

Avoid Heated & Treated Black Cat’s Eye

Due to treatments the Black Cat’s Eye stone loses its natural composition and thus loses its natural frequency. These heated and treated Cat’s Eye do not offer any healing benefits and should be avoided.

Check for Lab Certificate:

It is recommended that you should purchase Black Cat’s Eye gemstones along with a lab tested certificate which can determine its authenticity, treatment status and origin. Rudra Centre has been dealing in natural unheated untreated lab certified gemstones for the past 25 years. Our Cat’s Eye are certified from trusted labs like GIA, IGI, GLI and IGITL.

Why buy Black Cat’s Eye gemstone from Rudra Centre?

We only deal with untreated and unheated gemstones from their natural sources, which we energize in accordance with Vedic Vidhi, after more than 20 years of research and 100.000+ satisfied, healed, and empowered customers.

Can I give my used Black Cat’s Eye gemstone to someone else?

You should avoid it if you are wearing it. However, if you have not used it for an extended period, you can pass it on to someone else. It is recommended to not wear it for at least 2 weeks before giving it to someone else. You can also follow the cleansing and reenergizing process mentioned in the benefits section.

tabs.tab4_description:
For the best results it is highly recommended that one wears only 100% natural, unheated, and untreated Cat’s Eye gemstones. As per the Vedic scriptures, a heat treatment harms its sattvic nature, rendering the stone less effective and beneficial. Like other gemstones, the quality of Cat’s Eye is also determined by the four Cs (Color, Cut, Carat, Clarity).  

Color 

Black Cat's Eye is earthed in the darker shades of the color spectrum, typically ranging from deep green to dark black. 

Cut 

Best quality Black Cat’s Eye stones have cuts that maximize the effect of hue, tone, saturation and surface area, such as cabochon cuts. 

Carat 

Black Cat’s Eye of 4 carats is most popular in Vedic Astrology. Significant smaller and larger Black Cat’s Eye are used in contemporary jewelry. Generally, the price of Black Cat’s Eye rises as the size/weight/carat increases.   

Clarity 

For the clarity of a Black Cats Eye, the size, quantity, and overall appearance of inclusions are key factors. Like other gemstones, Cats Eyes do contain some inclusions visible, being from opaque to translucent in appearance. Those with no inclusions to the unaided eye are super-rare and valuable. Thus, the Black Cats Eyes with some inclusions are accepted as well. Black Cats Eyes with the least inclusions and best clarity are considered the best. 

Traders deal in Black Cats Eyes synthetic to natural but which are treated/heated and color enhanced, so it is important that you purchase the stone only from a reputed dealer with certification from a reputed lab.       

Black Cat’s Eye gemstone Price  

The cost of Black Cat's Eye gemstones varies greatly depending on a number of factors, including the gem's quality, size, colour, and clarity of the cat's eye effect. Stones with a sharp and well-defined cat's eye chatoyant phenomenon, excellent transparency, and few inclusions command a higher price. Consequently, the most expensive Black Cat's Eye gemstones are usually sourced from places known for producing high-quality gemstones with exceptional clarity and chatoyancy. 

Sri Lanka (formerly known as Ceylon) is the primary source of the finest Black Cat's Eye gemstones and has a long history of producing the highest quality chrysoberyl black cat's eye gemstones in the market, including some of the most sought-after dark green to black varieties with distinct cat's eye effects.

When a gemstone is heat-treated or undergoes the dying process, its healing properties are lost when it is worn. Cat’s Eye has numerous curative properties; to maximize its curative effects, only untreated Cat’s Eye stone should be worn.

The price of genuine, natural and unheated, untreated Black Cat’s Eye gemstones at Rudra Centre ranges from INR 2,100 to INR 33,000 (USD 25 to USD 405).

How to Identify or Test Original & Authentic Black Cat’s Eye?

The best way to check the authenticity of Cat’s Eye is by getting a Lab tested report from a reputed laboratory. Rudra Centre only deals with Vedic Astrology approved gemstones that are natural, untreated, and unheated. All our Cat’s Eye are certified by reputable labs like GIA, GLI, IGI and IGITL.

Look for flaws along with inclusions. Use a magnifying glass with at least 10x magnification to examine the Cat’s Eye carefully. Look for specks and blemishes, as they form with minute particles of other material. These flaws are strong evidence that a Cat’s Eye is genuine. Lab-created (fake) Cat’s Eye have no inclusions of this nature, and neither do natural Cat’s Eye, but if you find flaws, then your Cat’s Eye is genuine.

Examine the gemstone for air bubbles. Essentially, lab-created Cat’s Eye are glass that has undergone a process similar to that which forms natural Cat’s Eye. Since they are made of glass, they retain miniscule air bubbles after formation. If there are bubbles within the Cat’s Eye, it is not genuine. Be sure to inspect your Cat’s Eye from every angle by turning it over. There is a possibility that bubbles of air will only be evident from a single angle.

Look at how light is reflected by the Cat’s Eye. Turn off all the lights and shine your flashlight on the Cat’s Eye. If it is genuine, it will only reflect light of the same hue as itself. If it is a fake, made of glass, it will reflect colors other than the natural color of the gem.

Black Cat’s Eye Cleaning & Maintenance

It is essential to give your gemstone a thorough cleaning in order to preserve its luster, as regular use can cause it to become dull. This washing enables it to purge itself from negative energies as well. 

Black Cat's eye Chrysoberyl is resilient enough to be cleansed with ultrasonic cleansers or steamers, but care must always be taken. Chrysoberyl is considered to be exceptionally durable and resilient, but sapphire and diamond can readily damage it. 

Use a gentle cloth and plain soapy water to maintain your gemstones; avoid bleach and other abrasive household cleansers. Be careful to thoroughly rinse to remove any residue from detergents.
